_about: Each legislature's fixed facts for the balance of power (balance.py): seats in each chamber (S = Senate, the state's lower-house letter otherwise), the share of each house's seats it takes to override a veto ("majority": more than half, as in Indiana), and the governor serving now with their party. Party seat counts aren't here: they come from each session's member list. Update `governor` when a new one takes office (also GOVERNORS in the state's profile.py); `coalition` lists chambers a bipartisan coalition runs (Alaska's: no party controls them, whatever the seat counts say); `nonpartisan` marks a legislature elected without party labels (Nebraska's one house, L: no party counts, no dots on the front page's map); `note` says what seat counts alone don't (a bipartisan coalition running a chamber, an officially nonpartisan legislature). Checked 2026-11-07.

ak.note: Bipartisan coalitions run both houses in 2025–26: in the House, 14 Democrats, 5 independents and 2 Republicans (Speaker Bryce Edgmon is an independent); in the Senate, 9 Democrats and 5 Republicans (President Gary Stevens is a Republican). Overriding a veto takes the two houses meeting together: 40 of the 60 legislators, or 45 for an appropriation bill.

al.note: Overriding a veto takes a majority of each house's members (18 senators, 53 representatives). Kay Ivey is term-limited; a new governor takes office in January 2027.

id.note: Overriding a veto takes two-thirds of the members present in each house.

ky.note: Overriding a veto takes a majority of each house's members (20 senators, 51 representatives). Andy Beshear is term-limited; a new governor takes office in December 2027.

me.note: The House also seats two tribal representatives (the Passamaquoddy Tribe's and the Houlton Band of Maliseet Indians'), who don't vote on the floor. Overriding a veto takes two-thirds of the members present in each house.

mn.note: The House is tied 67–67 in 2025–26 and runs under a power-sharing agreement: Speaker Lisa Demuth is a Republican, and each committee has a Republican and a DFL co-chair. The DFL (the Democratic-Farmer-Labor Party, Minnesota's Democrats) holds the Senate 34–33. Overriding a veto takes two-thirds of each house (45 senators, 90 representatives).

mo.note: Overriding a veto takes two-thirds of each house's members (23 senators, 109 representatives), usually at the veto session in September.

mt.note: Overriding a veto takes two-thirds of the members present in each house during the session; after it adjourns, the Secretary of State polls the legislators by mail, and it takes two-thirds of each house's members. Constitutional amendments the Legislature proposes need 100 of the 150 legislators, both houses counted together.

ne.note: Nebraska's Legislature has one house of 49 senators, elected without party labels: officially nonpartisan, so no party holds it. Overriding a veto takes three-fifths of the senators, 30 of 49.

nm.note: Overriding a veto takes two-thirds of each house's members present and voting. Michelle Lujan Grisham is term-limited; a new governor takes office January 1, 2027.

nv.note: Overriding a veto takes two-thirds of each house (14 senators, 28 Assembly members). A bill vetoed after the session goes back to the next regular session (the Legislature meets in odd years), which can override it then.

ok.note: Overriding a veto of a bill with an emergency clause takes three-fourths of each house (36 senators, 76 representatives).

ri.note: Overriding a veto takes three-fifths of the members present and voting in each house.

sc.note: Overriding a veto takes two-thirds of the members present and voting in each house. Henry McMaster is term-limited; a new governor takes office in January 2027.

vt.note: Overriding a veto takes two-thirds of the members present in each house. Progressives who also run as Democrats are counted with the Democrats.

wv.note: Overriding a veto takes a majority of each house's members (18 senators, 51 delegates), two-thirds for the budget and supplementary appropriation bills; a veto after the session ends stands.
